pack_parameters._note: runtime data -- registry field names, permitted per the filtration contract

max_value.note: closed form; the underlying per-octave amplitude-sum telescopes to exactly 1.0 whenever every octave in a full contiguous range carries amplitude 1.0, which is always true here

wrap.applies_to: the x,y,z position arguments only -- never the fold divisor or cap bound

fold_cap.epsilon_precision: float literal in source, widened to double at the addition
fold_cap.smear_scale_multiplier_enters_at: the divisor only, never the cap bound
fold_cap.fold_formula: fold = floor(clamp_source/divisor + 1e-7) * divisor, where clamp_source = cap_bound if the cap condition holds, else yfrac
fold_cap.interpolation_weight_note: the y-axis blend weight is smoothstep(yfrac), the TRUE fraction -- folding only changes which lattice-corner value gets sampled, never the blend smoothness. Getting this backwards was caught and fixed during harness authoring; see AUDIT.md.

zero_divisor_fallback.reachability: divisor is a product/quotient of strictly-positive codec-bounded quantities; can never be zero under current pack schema

cap_below_y_zero.status: provably never binds for world Y < 0, at any octave, under any in-range pack parameters
cap_below_y_zero.note: the fold itself still occurs unconditionally below y=0 -- only the CAP sub-branch is dead there

skip_layer_construction.reachability: gated on a layer's amplitude being exactly zero; every layer this mechanism requests has amplitude 1.0 by the fixed, gapless octave ranges of Q1.2

derivative_noise_variant.status: entirely unreferenced in the whole decompiled tree, not just this mechanism

rng_construction.sampler_order_note: all three share ONE RandomSource instance, advanced in sequence across all three constructions
rng_construction.per_sampler_octave_order: highest frequency first (octave 0), then descending through coarser octaves in strict order to the sampler's coarsest octave
rng_construction.per_layer_draws: 3 floating-point draws (that layer's own xo,yo,zo offsets), then 256 draws performing an in-place 256-entry permutation shuffle

seed_derivation.method: positional fork of the world seed
seed_derivation.note: runtime salt string, permitted; read one level up from the mechanism itself, at its wiring site
